answer.text: The standard seat adjusts from 825 mm to 845 mm.
The low seat adjusts from 805 mm to 825 mm.
So the two seats are not the same adjustable height; the manual gives different ranges for them.
To confirm the exact setting for your motorcycle, check with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.

policy.text: Where the manual gives different values for the same thing, both are given and the rider is directed to confirm with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.
